name: TModLoader
description: Easily and quickly set up a configurable Terraria tModLoader server that automatically downloads mods using Steam Workshop IDs. . Features -Easy download of tModLoader mods from Steam Workshop -Scheduled world saving -Graceful shutdowns -Optional server config for precise setting control -GitHub automation to stay up-to-date with tModLoader's release cycle

ports.name: Server Port
ports.description: The port the server will run on. Terraria's default is 7777.

variables.name: Shutdown Message
variables.description: The message which will be sent to the in-game chat upon container shutdown.

variables.name: Autosave Interval
variables.description: The autosave interval (in minutes) in which the World will be saved.

variables.name: Auto Download Mod List
variables.description: A Comma Separated list of Workshop Mod IDs to download from Steam upon container startup. More information on Mod Workshop IDs can be found on the Github README.

variables.name: Enabled Mods
variables.description: A Comma Separated list of Workshop Mod IDs to enable on the tModLoader server upon startup. More information on Mod Workshop IDs can be found on the Github README.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: The Message of the Day which prints in the chat upon joining the server.

variables.name: Server Passworrd
variables.description: The password players must supply to join the server. Set this variable to N/A to disable.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The maximum number of players which can join the server at once.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: The name of the world file. This is seen in-game as well as will be used for the name of the .WLD file.

variables.name: World Size
variables.description: When generating a new world, this variable will be used to designate the size. 1 = Small, 2 = Medium, 3 = Large

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: The seed for a new world.

variables.name: Use Config File
variables.description: If you wish to use a config file to specify MOTD, Password, Max Players, World Name, World Size, World Seed, and a few other additional settings, set this to Yes

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: When generating a new world (and only when generating a new world), this variable will set the difficulty of the world. 1 = Normal, 2 = Master, 3 = Journey.

variables.name: Secure Mode
variables.description: Adds additional cheat protection. 0 = off, 1 = on

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Sets the language for the server. Available options are: en-US (English), de-DE (German), it-IT (Italian), fr-FR (French), es-ES (Spanish), ru-RU (Russian), zh-Hans (Chinese), pt-BR (Portuguese), pl-PL (Polish).

variables.name: NPC Stream
variables.description: Reduces enemy skipping, but increases bandwidth usage. The lower the number, the less skipping will happeb, but more data is sent. 0 is off.
